name: ncCut2D
author: tmuka
description: Turns a 2D drawing (DXF, SVG, PDF or Illustrator) into router G-code. Pick outside (with tabs), inside, on the line or pocket per colour or shape. End mills come from your Tool Library, with speeds and feeds for the material. Optional V-bit chamfer on top edges. Size fields take any unit. Preview the cut with a collision check, then load it into ncSender or save it to File Manager.
